verdict.rationale: Docs say bbox_annotation annotates the figures and charts the OCR model extracts, including user-requested descriptions or captions and chart-to-table conversion. Per-page blocks carry bounding boxes and structural labels, giving page-traceable positions. Community testers confirm embedded images are extracted and returned with coordinates. Missing for 10: first-party docs explicitly describing the returned image-crop payload and its coordinate schema, and independent hands-on corroboration of VLM figure summaries.
